ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Script Dropped Via PowerShell.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell creating a PowerShell file (.ps1). While often times this behavior is benign, sometimes it can be a sign of a dropper script trying to achieve persistence.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$")) AND  NOT (file_path = RGX(".*\\_\\_PSScriptPolicyTest\\_.*") OR (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\"))
